faq.title: Preguntas frecuentes
faq.subtitle: Encuentra respuestas a preguntas comunes sobre VexShield
faq.supportPrompt: Cannot find what you are looking for? Our support team is here to help.

faqs.question: What is VexShield?
faqs.answer: VexShield is a comprehensive anti-cheat solution designed for FiveM servers with real-time monitoring, intelligent detections, and a web dashboard.

faqs.question: How do I install VexShield?
faqs.answer: Buy a license, download the resource from your dashboard, upload it to resources, add ensure airshield to server.cfg, configure your IP and license key, then restart.

faqs.question: Do I need technical knowledge?
faqs.answer: Basic FiveM knowledge helps, but the dashboard is designed to be simple. Documentation and Discord support are available.

faqs.question: How does VexShield detect cheaters?
faqs.answer: It uses behavior analysis, signature checks, injection detection, resource monitoring, and network analysis.

faqs.question: Can I customize protections?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can enable protections, choose actions, configure blacklists, sensitivity, and webhook notifications.

faqs.question: Does VexShield support Discord?
faqs.answer: Yes. It supports Discord login, alerts, blacklist checks, and AirEye bot workflows.

faqs.question: Can I get a refund?
faqs.answer: New customers can request a refund according to the refund policy.

faqs.question: What support is available?
faqs.answer: Support is available through Discord, documentation, and staff assistance.

faqs.question: Can I extend my license?
faqs.answer: Yes. Renewals are manual and add full time to your license.
